Tests bytes input extraction API (extract)

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from pathlib import Path
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(bytes=Path("pdf/fake_memo.pdf").read_bytes(), filename="fake_memo.pdf", kind=ExtractInputKind("bytes"))
    result = await extract(input)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
